import Mathlib

theorem putnam_2020_a2
  (k : ℕ) :
  (∑ j ∈ Finset.Icc 0 k, 2 ^ (k - j) * Nat.choose (k + j) j) = 4 ^ k := by
  -- Base case: k = 0
  -- Left side: ∑_{j=0}^0 2^(0-j) * C(0+j,j) = 2^0 * C(0,0) = 1
  -- Right side: 4^0 = 1
  -- So they're equal
  have h_base : (∑ j ∈ Finset.Icc 0 0, 2 ^ (0 - j) * Nat.choose (0 + j) j) = 4 ^ 0 := by
    simp [Finset.sum_range_succ]
  
  -- Inductive step: assume true for k, prove for k+1
  -- We'll use strong induction on k
  have h_ind : ∀ n : ℕ, (∑ j ∈ Finset.Icc 0 n, 2 ^ (n - j) * Nat.choose (n + j) j) = 4 ^ n := by
    intro n
    induction' n with n ih
    · -- Base case n = 0
      simp [h_base]
    · -- Inductive step: assume for n, prove for n+1
      rw [Finset.sum_Icc_succ_top (by omega : 0 ≤ n + 1)]
      simp [ih, pow_add, pow_one, mul_assoc]
      -- Use the identity: C(n+1+j, j) = C(n+j, j) + C(n+j, j-1)
      -- Split the sum and rearrange terms
      have h₁ : ∑ j in Finset.range (n + 1), 2 ^ (n + 1 - j) * Nat.choose (n + 1 + j) j = 
                 ∑ j in Finset.range (n + 1), 2 ^ (n + 1 - j) * (Nat.choose (n + j) j + Nat.choose (n + j) (j - 1)) := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro j hj
        rw [Nat.choose_succ_succ]
        <;> simp_all [Finset.mem_range]
        <;> omega
      rw [h₁]
      -- Split into two sums and reindex
      have h₂ : ∑ j in Finset.range (n + 1), 2 ^ (n + 1 - j) * Nat.choose (n + j) j + 
                ∑ j in Finset.range (n + 1), 2 ^ (n + 1 - j) * Nat.choose (n + j) (j - 1) = 
                2 * ∑ j in Finset.range (n + 1), 2 ^ (n - j) * Nat.choose (n + j) j + 
                ∑ j in Finset.range (n + 1), 2 ^ (n + 1 - j) * Nat.choose (n + j) (j - 1) := by
        calc
          _ = ∑ j in Finset.range (n + 1), 2 ^ (n + 1 - j) * Nat.choose (n + j) j + 
              ∑ j in Finset.range (n + 1), 2 ^ (n + 1 - j) * Nat.choose (n + j) (j - 1) := rfl
          _ = ∑ j in Finset.range (n + 1), 2 * 2 ^ (n - j) * Nat.choose (n + j) j + 
              ∑ j in Finset.range (n + 1), 2 ^ (n + 1 - j) * Nat.choose (n + j) (j - 1) := by
            apply congr_arg (fun x => x + _)
            apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
            intro j hj
            rw [pow_succ]
            ring_nf
          _ = 2 * ∑ j in Finset.range (n + 1), 2 ^ (n - j) * Nat.choose (n + j) j + 
              ∑ j in Finset.range (n + 1), 2 ^ (n + 1 - j) * Nat.choose (n + j) (j - 1) := by
            simp [Finset.mul_sum]
      rw [h₂]
      -- Reindex the second sum
      have h₃ : ∑ j in Finset.range (n + 1), 2 ^ (n + 1 - j) * Nat.choose (n + j) (j - 1) = 
                ∑ j in Finset.range n, 2 ^ (n - j) * Nat.choose (n + 1 + j) j := by
        apply Finset.sum_bij' (fun j _ => j + 1) (fun j _ => j - 1)
        <;> simp_all [Finset.mem_range]
        <;> omega
      rw [h₃]
      -- Combine and simplify

                ∑ j in Finset.range n, 2 ^ (n - j) * Nat.choose (n + 1 + j) j =

            simp [Finset.sum_range_succ]
          _ = 2 * ∑ j in Finset.range n, 2 ^ (n - j) * Nat.choose (n + j) j +

            simp [mul_add, add_mul]
          _ = 3 * ∑ j in Finset.range n, 2 ^ (n - j) * Nat.choose (n + j) j + 
              2 * 2 ^ (n - n) * Nat.choose (n + n) n + 
              ∑ j in Finset.range n, 2 ^ (n - j) * (Nat.choose (n + j) j + Nat.choose (n + j) (j - 1)) := by
            apply congr_arg (fun x => x + _)
            apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
            intro j hj
            rw [Nat.choose_succ_succ]
            <;> simp_all [Finset.mem_range]
            <;> omega
          _ = 3 * ∑ j in Finset.range n, 2 ^ (n - j) * Nat.choose (n + j) j + 
              2 * 2 ^ (n - n) * Nat.choose (n + n) n + 
              ∑ j in Finset.range n, 2 ^ (n - j) * Nat.choose (n + j) j + 
              ∑ j in Finset.range n, 2 ^ (n - j) * Nat.choose (n + j) (j - 1) := by
            simp [Finset.sum_add_distrib]
          _ = 4 * ∑ j in Finset.range n, 2 ^ (n - j) * Nat.choose (n + j) j + 
              2 * 2 ^ (n - n) * Nat.choose (n + n) n + 
              ∑ j in Finset.range n, 2 ^ (n - j) * Nat.choose (n + j) (j - 1) := by
            simp [add_assoc]
            <;> ring_nf at *
            <;> simp_all [Finset.sum_range_succ]
            <;> omega
          _ = 4 * ∑ j in Finset.range n, 2 ^ (n - j) * Nat.choose (n + j) j + 
              2 * 2 ^ (n - n) * Nat.choose (n + n) n + 
              ∑ j in Finset.range n, 2 ^ (n - j) * Nat.choose (n + j) (j - 1) := rfl
      rw [h₄]
      -- Apply IH and simplify
      have h₅ : ∑ j in Finset.range n, 2 ^ (n - j) * Nat.choose (n + j) j = 4 ^ n - 2 ^ (n - n) * Nat.choose (n + n) n := by
        have h₅₁ : ∑ j in Finset.range (n + 1), 2 ^ (n - j) * Nat.choose (n + j) j = 4 ^ n := by
          simpa [Finset.sum_range_succ] using ih
        have h₅₂ : ∑ j in Finset.range (n + 1), 2 ^ (n - j) * Nat.choose (n + j) j = 
                   ∑ j in Finset.range n, 2 ^ (n - j) * Nat.choose (n + j) j + 
                   2 ^ (n - n) * Nat.choose (n + n) n := by
          simp [Finset.sum_range_succ]
        linarith
      rw [h₅]
      simp [pow_succ, mul_comm]
      <;> ring_nf at *
      <;> simp_all [Nat.choose_self, Nat.choose_zero_right, Nat.choose_one_right]
      <;> omega
  
  exact h_ind k

import Mathlib

theorem putnam_2020_a2 (k : ℕ) :
  (∑ j ∈ Finset.Icc 0 k, 2 ^ (k - j) * Nat.choose (k + j) j) = 4 ^ k := by
  have h_main : ∀ n : ℕ, (∑ j ∈ Finset.Icc 0 n, 2 ^ (n - j) * Nat.choose (n + j) j) = 4 ^ n := by
    intro n
    induction' n with n ih
    · -- Base case n = 0
      simp [Finset.sum_Icc_self]
    · -- Inductive step: assume true for n, prove for n+1
      rw [Finset.sum_Icc_succ_top (by omega)]
      -- Split sum into j=0..n and j=n+1
      have hlast : 2 ^ ((n + 1) - (n + 1)) * Nat.choose ((n + 1) + (n + 1)) (n + 1) 
        = Nat.choose (2 * n + 2) (n + 1) := by
        simp [Nat.sub_self, Nat.add_sub_cancel]
      rw [hlast]
      
      -- Factor out 2 from the first sum
      have hfactor :
          (∑ j ∈ Finset.Icc 0 n, 2 ^ (n + 1 - j) * Nat.choose (n + 1 + j) j)
        = 2 * (∑ j ∈ Finset.Icc 0 n, 2 ^ (n - j) * Nat.choose (n + 1 + j) j) := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro j hj
        rcases Finset.mem_Icc.1 hj with ⟨_, hle⟩
        have hsub : n + 1 - j = n - j + 1 := by omega
        rw [hsub]
        simp [pow_add, pow_one, mul_comm]
        <;> ring_nf
      
      -- Apply Pascal's identity
      have hpascal :
          (∑ j ∈ Finset.Icc 0 n, 2 ^ (n - j) * Nat.choose (n + 1 + j) j)
        = (∑ j ∈ Finset.Icc 0 n, 2 ^ (n - j) * Nat.choose (n + j) j)
          + (∑ j ∈ Finset.Icc 0 n, 2 ^ (n - j) * Nat.choose (n + j) (j - 1)) := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro j hj
        rcases Finset.mem_Icc.1 hj with ⟨_, hle⟩
        have hchoose := Nat.choose_succ_right (n + j) j
        simpa [Nat.add_comm, Nat.add_left_comm, Nat.add_assoc] using hchoose
      
      -- Shift index in second sum
      have hshift :
          (∑ j ∈ Finset.Icc 0 n, 2 ^ (n - j) * Nat.choose (n + j) (j - 1))
        = (∑ i ∈ Finset.Icc 0 (n - 1), 2 ^ ((n - 1) - i) * Nat.choose ((n - 1) + i) i) := by
        cases n with
        | zero => simp
        | succ n =>
          apply Finset.sum_bij' (fun i hi => i + 1) (fun i hi => i - 1)
          <;> simp [Finset.mem_Icc]
          <;> omega
      
      -- Combine everything
      calc
        (∑ j ∈ Finset.Icc 0 (n + 1), 2 ^ (n + 1 - j) * Nat.choose (n + 1 + j) j)
        = (∑ j ∈ Finset.Icc 0 n, 2 ^ (n + 1 - j) * Nat.choose (n + 1 + j) j) + Nat.choose (2 * n + 2) (n + 1) := by
          rw [Finset.sum_Icc_succ_top (by omega), hlast]
        _ = 2 * (∑ j ∈ Finset.Icc 0 n, 2 ^ (n - j) * Nat.choose (n + 1 + j) j) + Nat.choose (2 * n + 2) (n + 1) := by
          rw [hfactor]
        _ = 2 * ((∑ j ∈ Finset.Icc 0 n, 2 ^ (n - j) * Nat.choose (n + j) j)
                  + (∑ j ∈ Finset.Icc 0 n, 2 ^ (n - j) * Nat.choose (n + j) (j - 1))) + Nat.choose (2 * n + 2) (n + 1) := by
          rw [hpascal]
        _ = 2 * (∑ j ∈ Finset.Icc 0 n, 2 ^ (n - j) * Nat.choose (n + j) j)
            + 2 * (∑ j ∈ Finset.Icc 0 n, 2 ^ (n - j) * Nat.choose (n + j) (j - 1))
            + Nat.choose (2 * n + 2) (n + 1) := by
          ring
        _ = 2 * 4 ^ n + 2 * (∑ i ∈ Finset.Icc 0 (n - 1), 2 ^ ((n - 1) - i) * Nat.choose ((n - 1) + i) i)
            + Nat.choose (2 * n + 2) (n + 1) := by
          rw [ih, hshift]
        _ = 2 * 4 ^ n + 2 * 4 ^ (n - 1) + Nat.choose (2 * n + 2) (n + 1) := by
          rw [ih]
        _ = 4 ^ (n + 1) := by
          cases n with
          | zero => simp
          | succ n =>
            simp [pow_succ, Nat.choose_succ_succ]
            <;> ring_nf
            <;> norm_num
            <;> omega
  
  exact h_main k
